T-001.Title: Isolate the four attempt-pair regression inputs to synthetic current fixtures

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All four original input obligations are replaced inside `src/review/core.test.ts` by coverage that drives only explicitly constructed temporary synthetic fixtures. The replacement coverage contains no publisher bundle name literal (`C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY`, `C-CURSOR-INTEGRITY`, `C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6`) and reads no repository `.ngrace/changes/archive/` population. The number and organization of replacement `it` blocks are free; the four behavioral obligations and their counterweights are binding. The unrelated process-audit tests this slice leaves in place are unchanged.

Each selected synthetic bundle supplies a spec, a plan, and a run-ledger at asserted-present paths before any count. The spec and plan are parsed and passed to `validateChangeArtifact(artifact, "archive", root)` and the ledger to `validateRunLedgerArtifact`; each yields zero issues. Project-wide validation is not used as a substitute for this direct selected-artifact validation. The ledger is schema-valid and closed: it carries a recorded fail event and a recorded pass event for the declared task, each with explicit non-artifact source `WriteEvidence` content digests. The existing `writeLedgerEvents` helper (`src/review/core.test.ts:2546-2553`) is not reused unchanged because its allocation covers events 1-99 and carries no terminal event; new or extended local construction within this sole file produces the schema-valid allocation coverage and closing events.

The changed-digest silent case uses a synthetic archived bundle whose non-artifact source content digests differ across the recorded fail/pass pair. Reviewing it yields zero findings with code `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` and zero findings with code `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated`, and the attempt-pair audit reports it ran over at least one fail/pass pair (nonzero pair count), so the silence is measured over present fixtures and never over an empty or vanished population.

The positive real-CLI case uses a synthetic archived bundle whose recorded fail and pass events carry equal non-artifact source content digests. Driving the shipped CLI (`bun run ./src/grace.ts review --path <tempRoot> --change <fixture-id> --format json`) exits 0 and the parsed JSON contains exactly one finding with code `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree`, `severity` equal to `warning`, `anchorOrHunkKey` equal to the declared `attempt-pair:<task>:<failEventId>-><passEventId>`, a `file` under the synthetic bundle's `.ngrace/changes/archive/<fixture-id>/` path (`run` or `run-ledger.xml`), and a `findingId` matching `^[a-f0-9]{16}$`; the report declares the pair was audited (nonzero pair count). The adjacent warning-only synthetic project exits 0 naming the live warning, and the synthetic project carrying a current error exits 1.

The frozen ID lists `AUTHORING_ARCHIVE_C_IDS` and `HISTORICAL_CLOSE_C_IDS` are removed from `src/review/core.test.ts` once their remaining uses permit it (their only declaration and uses belong to the replaced historical-close input). The retired-code constant `RETIRED_ATTEMPT_PAIR_CODE` is retained for its catalog presence/absence and prose-agreement uses. No runtime source, mock, audit-disabling override, publisher-specific configuration, or consumer exemption is added, and no path outside `src/review/core.test.ts` is written.
